text: I can't tell you whether to buy a specific stock, but putting all your savings into any single company, Tesla included, carries a lot of risk because its price can swing sharply and you could lose a significant amount. Money you may need soon, like an emergency fund, is generally better kept in cash or savings, with only money you can afford to leave invested for the long term going into the market. If you'd like personalized guidance, you can reach out to Albert Genius in the app to talk through your goals and options.
